rules.name: Unsourced Factual Assertion
rules.desc: Significant factual, scientific, or statistical claims made without citations, primary sources, or verifiable provenance.

rules.name: Headline / Body Distortion
rules.desc: Misleading headline disparity where the article title or social preview contradicts or grossly inflates what the body text substantiates.

rules.name: Uncorroborated Anonymous Sourcing
rules.desc: Damaging assertions attributed exclusively to unnamed sources without explanatory justification or multiple independent corroborating points.

rules.name: Deceptive Context & Selective Omission
rules.desc: Quoting individuals or citing data while intentionally omitting critical qualifiers, timestamps, or full context that changes the fundamental meaning.

rules.name: Blurred Editorial Demarcation
rules.desc: Op-eds, speculative commentary, or sponsored marketing presented with the visual styling and framing of objective hard news.

rules.name: Satire Cloaking & Bad-Faith Camouflage
rules.desc: Malicious disinformation or defamatory falsehoods masquerading as satire or parody to evade accountability (Poe's Law Override applies).

rules.name: Sensational Exploitation of Tragedy
rules.desc: Gratuitous sensationalism exploiting private victims, minors, or grief for emotional engagement or ad clicks.

rules.name: Doxxing & Unjustified Privacy Intrusion
rules.desc: Publishing private phone numbers, home addresses, or private identifying documents without legitimate public interest justification.

rules.name: Undisclosed Commercial or Political Conflict
rules.desc: Favorable coverage of products, donors, or political candidates without disclosing financial, ownership, or affiliate ties.

rules.name: Disguised Native Advertising
rules.desc: Paid promotional marketing designed to mimic an independent investigative article.

rules.name: Stealth Modification & Silent Edits
rules.desc: Substantive post-publication changes to key factual assertions, numbers, or quotes without publishing an explicit, timestamped editorial correction notice.

rules.name: Ghost or Anonymous Publishing
rules.desc: News reports published without an author byline, editorial board masthead, or organization contact.

rules.name: Lack of Transparent Corrections Policy
rules.desc: Absence of a visible corrections log, contact channel for factual disputes, or retraction standards.
